summary: IperionX Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a firm commitment public offering of 2,275,000 American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing 10 ordinary shares. ADSs trade on Nasdaq (IPX) at $28.36 (last sale 7/6/26). The public offering price is $21.98 per ADS, total proceeds approximately $47.0 million to the company. Underwriters include Cantor, Roth Capital Partners, and B. Riley Securities. The offering is an ordinary capital markets transaction—not a special situation—and proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Risk-arb watchers note typical follow-on pricing discount as the only structural feature.
